entries.declaration: function drops(address token) view returns (uint128 amount, uint128 perBranch, uint64 registeredAt, uint32 lastId, uint32 nextId, uint64 branches, uint128 claimed, bool recovered)
entries.explanation: Read the token-keyed drop snapshot/accounting record. Earlier generation returns eight flat values; URC5 returns nine including mode. Neither is a current-wallet entitlement by itself.
entries.units: Addresses identify roles/assets; booleans are flags; IDs/counts are integers, not amounts. Distribution amounts/perBranch use raw authenticated distribution-token units (launched-token drops publish 18 decimals); branch/charter counts and snapshot blocks are unscaled integers; timestamp fields use Unix seconds. Snapshot cursor IDs are not token amounts. Mode is an enum requiring generation-specific meaning.
